Strategically located in the industrial heart of North Rhine-Westphalia, **Petrex GmbH**, headquartered at Wachtendonker Straße 11 in D-47906 Kempen, Germany, stands as a premier specialist in the distribution and international marketing of high-quality chemical raw materials. Since its establishment, the company has developed a reputation as a reliable and agile partner within the European chemical landscape, bridging the gap between global petrochemical producers and specialized industrial end-users.

The core expertise of Petrex GmbH lies in the procurement and supply of liquid chemical products, with a particular focus on hydrocarbons and solvents. Their extensive portfolio includes essential aromatics, such as Toluene and Xylene, as well as various aliphatic solvents and specialty chemicals that serve as the backbone for diverse sectors, including the automotive, coatings, construction, and pharmaceutical industries. By maintaining deep-rooted relationships with major refineries and chemical manufacturers worldwide, Petrex ensures a consistent and high-quality supply chain even in volatile market conditions.

What truly distinguishes Petrex GmbH is its commitment to "tailor-made" service. Recognizing that the modern chemical industry requires more than just standard product delivery, the company offers bespoke logistical solutions, including just-in-time deliveries and specialized storage options. Their location in Kempen is strategically advantageous, allowing them to leverage Germany’s sophisticated transport infrastructure to serve the DACH region and broader European markets efficiently.

Furthermore, Petrex GmbH operates with a strict adherence to safety and environmental standards, ensuring full compliance with REACH regulations and industry-specific safety protocols. By combining technical proficiency with a customer-centric philosophy, the company continues to foster long-term partnerships built on transparency, reliability, and an unwavering focus on the specific needs of the chemical processing industry. Whether handling bulk shipments or specialized smaller orders, Petrex GmbH remains a cornerstone of German chemical trade excellence.
